name: Travis CI
label: Travis CI API v3
description: Travis CI API v3 via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://docs.travis-ci.com/user/developer/ and https://developer.travis-ci.com/. Operations: build_get, build_list, build_cancel, build_restart, build_trigger. V3 sends header Travis-API-Version: 3 via extraHeaders (https://docs.travis-ci.com/user/triggering-builds/). Auth secret api_token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: build_get | build_list | build_cancel | build_restart | build_trigger. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'build_get'.

schema.label: build_id
schema.description: Travis build id for build_get, build_cancel, build_restart. Example: 123456789.

schema.label: slug
schema.description: Repository slug owner/name, URL-encoded as owner%2Fname in the path. Required for build_list and build_trigger. Example: travis-ci%2Ftravis-core.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: build_list page size (Travis v3 limit). Positive integer. Example: 25.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: build_list offset for pagination. Non-negative integer. Example: 0.

schema.label: branch
schema.description: Git branch to build (build_trigger) or filter (build_list). Example: master. Nested as request.branch on trigger. https://docs.travis-ci.com/user/triggering-builds/

schema.label: sha
schema.description: Commit SHA to build on build_trigger. Omit to use the branch tip. Example: bf944c952724dd2f00ff0c466a5e217d10f73bea. Nested as request.sha.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Commit/request message override on build_trigger. Example: API build. Nested as request.message.

schema.label: config
schema.description: Travis job config overlay on build_trigger (env, script, …). Keys override .travis.yml. Example: {"script":"echo FOO"}. Nested as request.config.

schema.label: merge_mode
schema.description: How request.config merges with .travis.yml on build_trigger. EXACT: deep_merge_append | deep_merge | merge | replace. Example: deep_merge.

schema.label: state
schema.description: build_list filter. Accepted: created | started | passed | failed | canceled | errored. Example: passed.

schema.label: event_type
schema.description: build_list filter. Accepted: push | pull_request | api | cron. Example: api.

schema.label: sort_by
schema.description: build_list sort. Example: id:desc. Official Travis v3 collection sort_by.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: build_get, build_list, build_cancel, build_restart, build_trigger. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Travis CI API token. Authorization: token <token>. Header Travis-API-Version: 3 is sent via extraHeaders. travis-ci.com (org is legacy).

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).
